reportincident-dialog-server-error: Waan ka xunnahay, waxay u muuqataa in adeegu aanu ka jawaabayn. Fadlan isku day inaad dib u gudbiso.

reportincident-emaildialog-title: Iimayl la xaqiijiyay ayaa loo baahan yahay
reportincident-emaildialog-content: Waxaan u baahan nahay {{GENDER:|iimaylkaaga}} la xaqiijiyay si aan kuu siino warbixinno ku saabsan {{GENDER:|warbixinta}} ama aan kula soo xiriirno haddii loo baahdo. Fadlan ku dar ama xaqiiji {{GENDER:|iimaylkaaga}} adigoo ka adeegsanaya dejinta akoonkaaga ka hor intaadan gudbin warbixin.
reportincident-confirmedemail-required: Cinwaan iimayl la xaqiijiyay ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo gudbiyo warbixinta dhacdada.
